args.description: One native 64x64 full-body LEFT-facing pixel-art enemy for Dungeon Matcher, transparent background. Manta-folk control specialist, flattened manta brow and wing-like shoulder fins close to body, slim dark planted legs. Holds a folded warm rope net with a few shell weights. Ink-blue back, pale underside, tiny dull-metal weights. Keep folded net readable beside body, not covering the entire body. Charming compact grounded combat stance. Eyes must be a single solid very dark color, no white sclera, no white eye highlights or pupils. Consistent one-pixel #0A0D11 contour, crisp square pixels, broad connected shading clusters, top-left light, 2-3 shades per distinct material, restrained interior detail. Preserve common native body density with the approved reference; roughly 48-59px body height, feet contact near bottom canvas. One character, one stance, one direction; no text, shadow disc, particles, scenery or glow.

style_image.usage_description: Copy rendering, outline and shading discipline only. New species and equipment as described. Solid dark eyes.
